title: Buckling Branch Jukebox
description: A static offline toy sandbox demonstrating post-bifurcation branch diversity in a slender 3D beam under load. Fuses Bi-FORK's focus on coherent whole futures and post-bifurcation diversity with a symmetry-aware orbit dial for a toy beam sandbox.

paper.title: Bi-FORK: Bifurcation-Aware Flow Matching for Sampling Diverse Solutions of Inverse Problems

novelty: No known implementation (not verified). This demo fuses Bi-FORK's bifurcation diversity concept with an interactive toy beam sandbox featuring a symmetry-aware orbit dial that changes view only (not branch state), persistent branch sign per sample, and a clustered/spread comparison mode with envelope-aware amplitude scaling.
how_it_works: Generates all trajectories locally in JavaScript from a declared toy rule. Uses 33 evenly spaced material points x in [0,1], 49 fixed playback frames, and nine fixed candidate seeds q = [-1,-0.75,-0.5,-0.25,0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1]. Normalized load L is clamped to [0,1]; imperfection e is clamped to [-0.15,0.15]. Toy critical load Lc=0.55. At frame load l(t)=L*t, the shared centerline before and at critical load is y=e*sin(pi*x)*min(l/Lc,1). Above critical load, signed branch score r=q+6e determines branch b=+1 when r>=0 else -1. Post-critical amplitude A=min(0.30, 0.30*sqrt((l-Lc)/(1-Lc))). Effective amplitude Aeff=min(A, max(0, 0.36-|e|)) respects the envelope |y|<=0.36. Trajectory: y=e*sin(pi*x)+b*Aeff*sin(pi*x). Branch sign fixed for entire trajectory. Spread mode applies deterministic one-sided amplitude reduction from Aeff toward max(0.80*Aeff, Aeff-0.04), clamped to envelope, for post-critical frames only.

controls.orbit: Range [-180,180] step 1 — camera orbit around beam axis (view only)
controls.branch: Button group (+/−) — selects physical branch for left pane
controls.mode: Button group (Clustered/Spread) — ensemble display mode for right pane
controls.touch: Drag on beam canvas rotates camera orbit
controls.keyboard: All controls focusable and operable by keyboard
controls.reduced_motion: Respects prefers-reduced-motion: auto-play pauses by default

provenance_notice: Locally generated toy trajectories. Equations and values are illustrative; these are not Bi-FORK output, validated mechanics, or evidence about real branch likelihoods.
